title: What If Spotify Listeners Were a Country?
description:
What if every Spotify listener moved into one country?

Sources:
- Hypebot: Spotify Q3 2026 - 788M users and 306M subscribers: https://www.hypebot.com/spotify-q3-2026-788m-users-and-306m-subscribers/
- Wikipedia: List of countries and dependencies by population: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_population

Population comparison: India 1.43 billion, China 1.40 billion, United States 342 million (official estimates listed on Wikipedia). Not financial advice.

#shorts #spotify #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you press play, ask yourself:

scenes.narration: What if every Spotify listener moved into one country?
In the third quarter of 2026, Spotify had 788 million monthly users.
That country would be the third biggest on Earth. Only India and China have more people.
It would have more than twice as many people as the United States.
But only 306 million of them pay for Premium. The other 499 million listen with ads.
So Spotify gets paid both ways: by subscribers, and by advertisers.
